{{Top|leg}}
A '''calling tree''' was a system used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to communicate. Every [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in the tree must be in contact with two other ships, and those ships would be in contact with two other ships. This would allow a whole [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] to remain in constant contact, especially when under attack by an enemy force.

After the [[Destruction of Sernpidal]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] set up a calling tree with the convoy fleeing the [[Sernpidal/Legends|planet]], to better defend against its [[Yuuzhan Vong]] destroyers, and their swarms of [[Grutchin|bugs]].
